## Source Name
Name and URL of the data source.

## What It Provides
What type of data (satellite imagery, news articles, incident reports)?

## Resolution / Coverage
Geographic coverage, image resolution, temporal range, etc.

## Access & Licensing
How is it accessed? Is it free? What are the licence terms?

## How It Improves the Project
What gap does this fill compared to existing sources?
